title: GridView curated season snapshot metadata
description: The curated, repository-owned metadata a provider-backed season snapshot carries (runtime activation decision O-14): the curated dataset version, published as `contentVersion`, and the season's display label. Never read from, or inferred from, a provider response. `attributionVersion` is not held here: it is the `version` of the data-source attribution record. `mediaVersion` is not held either: provider-backed snapshots publish no media and carry `null`. One record per season, stored under that season's directory.

datasetVersion.description: Identifies the curated dataset a snapshot was built from. A curator issues a new value whenever the curated identities, names or mappings that feed a provider-backed snapshot change, and never reuses one. Same shape as the existing contentVersion values: the issue date and a same-day counter.

seasonLabel.description: The season's display label (Season.label), or null when none is curated.
